_readme: Each Tatari's base skill as the in-game skill panel shows it: the numbers the wiki does not have.
Read off the game's own skill panel, by screenshot or screen recording, and checked by eye against
it. Values are kept exactly as the panel writes them ('130%', '4.5s', 'After Every 3 Attacks'),
because units and wording differ from row to row and a number without its unit is a guess.
sections: the skill's own rows first (heading null), then one per effect box the panel shows,
in its order, with the box's text. arenaFactor is the panel's last box, kept apart because it
applies only in Gold Rush and Arena: a skill's base damage against another Tatari is multiplied
by it. A Tatari with only arenaFactor has not had its full panel recorded yet.
Every player sees the same numbers; they do not change with account progress.

sections.heading: Aura: Water
sections.text: Heals all allies continuously. The healing effect for non-Water allies is reduced by 50%. Aura: Water can be stacked, but cannot take effect in some game modes.
